## Variables

### EMBED\_THEME\_TOKENS

```ts
const EMBED_THEME_TOKENS: object;
```

The embed themes' default chrome tokens, for surfaces outside Daisy (the
loader's launcher in a host page's shadow root). `styles.css` defines the same
values; a test keeps the two in step.

#### Type Declaration

| Name                                          | Type        | Default value |
| --------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ------------- |
| <a id="property-embed"></a> `embed`           | `object`    | -             |
| `embed.base100`                               | `"#ffffff"` | `"#ffffff"`   |
| `embed.baseContent`                           | `"#1f2328"` | `"#1f2328"`   |
| `embed.primary`                               | `"#2f5fd0"` | `"#2f5fd0"`   |
| `embed.primaryContent`                        | `"#ffffff"` | `"#ffffff"`   |
| <a id="property-embed-dark"></a> `embed-dark` | `object`    | -             |
| `embed-dark.base100`                          | `"#1b1d21"` | `"#1b1d21"`   |
| `embed-dark.baseContent`                      | `"#e8eaed"` | `"#e8eaed"`   |
| `embed-dark.primary`                          | `"#7aa2f7"` | `"#7aa2f7"`   |
| `embed-dark.primaryContent`                   | `"#000000"` | `"#000000"`   |

### readableContentColor()

```ts
function readableContentColor(hex): "#ffffff" | "#000000";
```

Black or white, whichever has the higher WCAG contrast on `hex`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type     |
| --------- | -------- |
| `hex`     | `string` |

#### Returns

`"#ffffff"` \| `"#000000"`

### embedThemeProperties()

```ts
function embedThemeProperties(options): EmbedThemeProperties;
```

Project host inputs onto the embed themes' custom properties. The host applies
them (for example with `style.setProperty`) beside `data-theme="embed"` or
`data-theme="embed-dark"`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                      |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `options` | [`EmbedThemeOptions`](#embedthemeoptions) |

#### Returns

[`EmbedThemeProperties`](#embedthemeproperties)
